name: Ikegami Honmonji Rouho Kaikan
accessSummary: Tokyu Ikegami Line, Ikegami Station: 10 min walk / Toei Asakusa Line, Nishi-Magome Station South Exit: 12 min walk / JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, Omori Station: 20 min by bus bound for Ikegami Station, get off at "Honmonji-mae" and walk 5 min (access as described by Ikegami Honmonji)
hours: Inquiries accepted 10:00-16:30, open all year (closed Aug 13-15 and Dec 29 - Jan 3). For meetings and training, the hall staff handle everything from the room layout to the setup. Overnight stays are also possible if needed (depending on the content, accommodation, training, etc. may not be accepted). Fees may differ depending on the use (dining, meetings, training, etc.). The capacities in the room table are the seated / standing-buffet values.

ops.catering: For meetings and training, boxed meals and tea are available. Outside food and drink are not welcome. (Source: http://honmonji.jp/enjoy/rouho.html)
ops.restaurants: There is a restaurant on the 1F, where private-room dining is available with dishes from Ningyocho Imahan (Ikegami Honmonji Store) and the kaiseki restaurant 味彩. Reserve dining by 1 week before the planned date. The number of Ningyocho Imahan dishes that can be served is limited because of the arrangement with the 1F restaurant. (Source: http://honmonji.jp/enjoy/rouho.html)
ops.parking: There is a free parking lot right in front, holding about 100 vehicles. (Source: http://honmonji.jp/enjoy/rouho.html)
